I'm PyBot! An AI created to show how input becomes response using tokenization, TF-IDF vectorization, and intent matching.
NLP (Natural Language Processing) is the field of AI that enables computers to read, decipher, understand, and make sense of human language in a valuable way.
Here's my pipeline: 1) Tokenize text into words, 2) Clean & stem words, 3) Convert text to TF-IDF mathematical vectors, 4) Calculate Cosine Similarity with known intents, 5) Select the best response!
At a high level: Human Text -> Tokenization -> Stopword Removal -> Vectorization (Numbers) -> Similarity Scoring -> Response Selection.
